name: qlrisk_backtest
title: VaR / ES backtest and PLA test
description: Validate a risk model. mode='portfolio' backtests the book's historical VaR and ES over test_days of (synthetic or supplied) history and runs the FRTB P&L attribution test: exceptions, Kupiec POF, Christoffersen independence, Basel traffic-light zone and multiplier, Acerbi-Szekely ES Z-tests, PLA Spearman / KS zone. mode='var_series' / 'es_series' / 'pla' test series you supply (P&L, VaR/ES forecasts as positive losses, HPL and RTPL). Trades take the inputs of each product's qlrisk_price_<product> tool (rates in percent, spreads in basis points, maturity as a tenor like 5Y); confidence levels are in percent (99 = 99%). Inputs: trades, mode, confidence_pct, test_days; the rest (market_data, reporting_currency, history, lookback, include_series, pnl, var_forecasts, es_forecasts, labels, hpl, rtpl, es_confidence_pct) in the optional `advanced` object. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}, {"product": "EquityOption", "trade_id": "SPX-P", "maturity": "6M", "notional": 1000000, "ticker": "SPX", "strike": 5000, "option_type": "put", "counterparty_id": "BANK-B"}], "confidence_pct": 99} gives Backtest over 250 days: 1 VaR exceptions (green, multiplier 3.0); ES green; PLA green on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
